summary: Caesars Entertainment (CZR) filed an 8-K on May 27, 2026, disclosing a definitive merger agreement with Fertitta Gaming Holdco, whereby a subsidiary will merge into Caesars, taking it private. Stockholders (excluding dissenting and rollover shares) will receive $31.00 per share in cash, plus a ticking fee of $0.00715/day starting June 26, 2027, if closing is delayed. The board unanimously approved the deal and recommends stockholder adoption. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals and stockholder vote. The expected close timeline and regulatory clock are not specified. Watch for any competing bids or regulatory hurdles affecting the risk-arb spread.
